title: Rotini Spec Schema
description: Schema for a Rotini CLI definition spec file.

$schema.description: URL identifying the rotini spec schema version. The version segment must match the rotini binary version used.

command.description: The CLI's root command. Same recursive Command shape as every sub-command (one type for the root and all sub-commands); the root must use 'name' (not '$ref'). Command-scoped concerns — doc-fields, inputs, sub-commands, remote commands — live here; program-scoped concerns (configuration_files, metadata, schemas) live at the document level beside it.

configuration_files.description: Config-file sources the program loads at startup (document-level). Per-command 'config' inputs bind typed values from these by name + key.

metadata.description: Build-time metadata vars injected via go ldflags (document-level).

schemas.description: Reusable named schema definitions (document-level). Referenced elsewhere via "$ref": "#/schemas/<Name>".

Command.description: A command node in the CLI command tree — the root command and every sub-command share this recursive shape. Declared inline (with 'name') or composed from another spec file (with '$ref'). When used as the root (the top-level 'command'), it must use 'name'.

name.description: Command name used in routing. As the root command (the top-level 'command') this is the binary name and must be set — the root cannot use '$ref'.

$ref.description: Path to another rotini spec file whose root command is statically composed in as this sub-command. Relative to this spec file. When set, 'name' optionally overrides the grafted sub-command name. Not valid on the root command.

aliases.description: Additional names that invoke this command. Command aliases affect dispatch routing; use identifiers on flags for flag aliases.

timeout.description: Command execution timeout. Uses Go duration format (e.g. "10s", "1m30s"). Empty or omitted means no timeout.

inputs.description: Typed inputs for this command: flags, arguments, config values, env variables, and stdin.

summary.description: Short one-liner shown next to this command in its parent's generated Commands list. Applies even when a verbatim 'help' string is set, since it feeds the parent's list — not this command's own page.

description.description: Long description block shown atop this command's generated help page. Ignored when 'help' (verbatim) is set.

usage.description: Usage-line override. When omitted, rotini derives one from the command's shape. Ignored when 'help' is set.

header.description: Text rendered above the description block. Ignored when 'help' is set.

footer.description: Text rendered at the bottom of the page. Ignored when 'help' is set.

headings.description: Section heading overrides for the generated page; sane defaults fill any unset heading. Ignored when 'help' is set.

examples.description: Example command-line invocations, rendered one per line. Ignored when 'help' is set.

help.description: Exact, verbatim help page for this command. When set, rotini writes it byte-for-byte (no rendering) and ignores the structured help fields (description/usage/header/footer/examples/headings); 'summary' is still used in the parent's Commands list. When unset, rotini generates the page from the structured fields.

man.description: Exact, verbatim man page for this command (the man feature's per-command escape, mirroring 'help'). When set, rotini writes it byte-for-byte and ignores the structured doc-fields for the man page; when unset, the man page is rendered from those fields through the man template.

markdown.description: Exact, verbatim markdown page for this command (the markdown feature's per-command escape, mirroring 'help'). When set, rotini writes it byte-for-byte and ignores the structured doc-fields for the markdown page; when unset, the markdown page is rendered from those fields through the markdown template.

output.description: This command's output shape, as a JSON-schema type. rotini generates a typed '<Prefix>Output' Go struct (or a named-type alias when it is a '$ref' to a document-level schema) for the handler to use however it likes — it wires NO flag and triggers NO rendering. Handlers have no return type by design, so 'output' is an opt-in building block, never a framework-enforced contract.

hidden.description: When true, the command is omitted from its parent's generated Commands list (it still dispatches on the command line).

deprecated.description: Deprecation message; the command is annotated as deprecated in its parent's generated Commands list.

commands.description: Sub-commands of this command (inline or composed via $ref).

remote_commands.description: Co-located remote binaries dispatched as first-class sub-commands of this command.

HelpHeadings.description: Section heading overrides for generated help pages.

var.description: Exported Go identifier for the ldflag var. Rotini declares this as a package-level var in the framework package. Inject at build time: -ldflags "-X <module>/<framework-pkg>.<var>=<value>"

default.description: Fallback value used when the ldflag has not been applied at build time. Becomes the var's initial value in the generated file.

BaseSchema.description: Shared fields for Schema and InputSchema. JSON Schema Draft 7 does not support additionalProperties: false on schemas that use allOf for inheritance — strictness is enforced by Go's DisallowUnknownFields at parse time.

$ref.description: Reference to a named schema in the top-level schemas map (e.g. '#/schemas/MySchema'). Resolved at codegen time.

type.description: The type used to parse and store the value. Accepts both Go type names (bool, int, float64, []string, duration, map) and JSON Schema standard names (boolean, integer, number, array, object) — both are equivalent. For a stdlib or third-party Go type (e.g. time.Time, uuid.UUID), set 'import' to the backing package path.

import.description: Optional Go import path backing 'type'. Set it when 'type' references a stdlib or third-party package whose name rotini does not already know (e.g. 'github.com/google/uuid' for uuid.UUID; 'net/url' for *url.URL). Omit (or leave empty) for builtins and rotini's own type aliases (string, int, duration, …) — codegen treats omitted/empty as 'no import'. The aliased form 'alias path' renames the import to avoid a clash (e.g. 'urlx github.com/me/url'). Codegen dedupes identical entries across the spec.

enum.description: Allowed values; parsed values are validated against this list

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match (string type only)

Schema.description: JSON Schema-inspired type definition used for output/response and object property schemas. The 'required' field is a string array of required property names (JSON Schema object semantics). For input schemas where 'required' means 'must be provided', use InputSchema instead.

required.description: Required property names for object schemas (standard JSON Schema semantics).

InputSchema.description: Extended schema for input definitions (flags, arguments, env vars, config values, stdin). Inherits all BaseSchema fields and adds input-level metadata. The 'required' field here is a boolean indicating whether this input must be provided — unlike Schema where 'required' is a string array of property names.

required.description: When true, the input must be provided (or stdin must not be empty for stdin inputs). Note: this is a boolean — unlike the string-array 'required' on Schema.

default.description: Default value applied when the input is not provided

file.description: Config file logical name to read from (config inputs only)

key.description: Key path within the config file (config inputs only, e.g., 'server.port')

schema.description: Type definition and input-level metadata (type, required, default, enum, nullable, constraints)

summary.description: Short one-liner shown next to this flag in the Flags section of generated help.

hidden.description: When true, the flag is omitted from generated help (it still parses on the command line).

deprecated.description: Deprecation message; the flag is annotated as deprecated in generated help.

identifiers.description: CLI flag identifiers (e.g., '--force', '-f'). When absent, '--<name>' is auto-derived.

schema.description: Type definition and input-level metadata (type, required, default, enum, nullable, constraints)

summary.description: Short one-liner shown next to this argument in the Arguments section of generated help.

hidden.description: When true, the argument is omitted from generated help (it still parses on the command line).

deprecated.description: Deprecation message; the argument is annotated as deprecated in generated help.

name.description: Logical name for this config value

schema.description: Type definition and input-level metadata (required, default, file, key)

name.description: Logical name for this env var input

schema.description: Type definition and input-level metadata (required, default, variable)
Type definition for stdin content. Set required: true in schema to error when stdin is empty.

arguments.description: Positional argument inputs for this command

config.description: Config-value inputs for this command, bound from a document-level configuration_files source by key.

stdin.description: Declares expected stdin format and schema for this command

name.description: Name of the remote command. The dispatched binary must be named <program>-<name> and located in the same directory as the host binary.

aliases.description: Additional names that invoke this remote command.

summary.description: Short one-liner shown next to this remote command in its parent's generated Commands list.

description.description: Long description block for this remote command's generated help page.

timeout.description: Host-side timeout for the remote binary execution. Uses Go duration format (e.g. "10s", "1m30s"). Empty or omitted means no timeout.

name.description: Logical name for the config file (e.g., 'app-config')

schema.description: When set, generates a typed config struct and validates required fields at load time.
